overview: Blood River Run is the corrupted artery of Bloodfalls, carrying vampyric energy and void-taint throughout the canyon.
history: The river was once a natural waterway before void-scar contamination turned it crimson.
Coterie ritualists began siphoning power from the river’s corrupted currents.
Sanguine beasts mutated from prolonged exposure to the crimson water.
Crimson rapids formed where void fractures intersected the riverbed.
The river became the main supply route for vampyric operations.
hooks: A crimson rapid begins surging unpredictably.
Sanguine beasts gather near a void-scar fissure.
A Coterie courier uses the river to transport a ritual artifact.
Crimson water levels rise suddenly, threatening nearby zones.
